packageRules.description: Runtime minor/patch updates are bundled weekly by the update-deps skill: keep them listed in the Dependency Dashboard and open a PR only on demand
One weekly auto-merged devDependencies bundle instead of one PR (and one patch release) per package

Widen peer ranges instead of bumping them: the shared javascript preset forces rangeStrategy 'bump' globally, which narrows the range modules are built against (^12.0.0 -> ^12.2.1) without gaining anything. Widening stays silent for in-range releases and opens a PR only when a new major has to be allowed
